findings.title: Include the raised Log square in its interaction shape
findings.body: The new `contentShape(Rectangle())` uses the unshifted VStack bounds, while the 44-point Log square is still offset upward by 12 points. This excludes the square’s visible upper 12-point strip from the button’s interaction region, so taps there no longer select Log despite being inside the control. Keep the expanded hit area inclusive of the raised square instead of replacing it with the unshifted rectangle.

findings.title: Restrict fixed label line boxes to standard Dynamic Type
findings.body: Both tab-label locations now force an 11-point height, but their fonts still grow through `@ScaledMetric tabLabelSize`. At accessibility Dynamic Type sizes the text needs substantially more vertical space, while these fixed frames keep the labels only 3 points below their icons (2 points below the Log square), constraining or overlapping the enlarged text instead of preserving its intrinsic-height layout. Apply the measured 11-point boxes only to the standard-size presentation and retain an expanding layout for larger text.
